entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Support for serializing/deserializing `float[]` as `Float32Array` via Blazor JSInterop #67926
  • Perf improvement: updates #67924
  • Perf improvement: antiforgery-noop, fortunes_dapper, mTls-handshakes-kestrel #67923
  • Different antiforgery behavior on Windows and Linux ASPNET Core 11 preview #67922
  • Support certificate lookup by thumbprint in Kestrel #67920
  • [DirectTls] Add metrics, tracing, and logging on par with the Sockets transport and runtime epoll engine #67916
    .NET 11 Planning
  • [Experimental] [DirectTls] Support ClientCertificateMode.DelayCertificate (post-handshake client authentication) #67915
    .NET 11 Planning
  • [Experimental] [Perf] Restore accept4() single-syscall accept path for the DirectTls transport (Connection: close) #67913
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Output Caching: MemoryCacheEntryOptions.Size omits retained cache-key bytes from SizeLimit accounting #67911
  • DirectTls transport — public API #67909
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Hardening: make Response/Output cache base-key serialization injective across PathBase and Path #67907
  • Singleton HybridCache is created twice when RedisCache uses ConnectionMultiplexerFactory — re-entrant GetService<HybridCache>() during DefaultHybridCache construction breaks RemoveByTagAsync #67904

Closed

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #67644
  • [API Proposal]: Drop the validatable type interfaces #67185
    .NET 11 Planning
  • `FormOptions.MultipartHeadersLengthLimit` not enforced when a multipart header line spans multiple `BufferedReadStream` buffers #67838
  • Expose Authorization Result and Add Forbidden State to Blazor AuthorizeView #67885
  • Failed to restore dogfooding tests due to error NU1902: Package 'AngleSharp' 0.9.9 has a known moderate severity vulnerability #67902
  • Design for CellClass support to PropertyColumn and TemplateColumn in QuickGrid #67872
  • [Test] A test issue #67906
  • Add IEndpointMetadataProvider to UnauthorizedHttpResult #65491
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Harden wildcard matching with empty segments inside #67756
  • [Openapi] How to achieve custom OneOfToAllOfNullableTransformer #64651
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Implement RFC 9931 §8 for HTTP/1.1 CONNECT in Kestrel #67929
    area-networking
  • Fix url normalizer backslashes #67928
  • fix: honor OpenAPI transformer registration order #67925
    community-contribution
  • Delete dead code in DelegateOpenApiDocumentTransformer #67921
  • Drop Microsoft.AspNetCore.Grpc.Swagger #67919
  • Reshape BrowserOptions server-to-client configuration API per review #67918
  • Rename ConfigureHostApplicationBuilder to ConfigureWebApplicationBuilder #67917
  • Expose InitialItemIndex parameter and ScrollToItemAsync method on QuickGrid  #67914
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-quickgrid, 11.0-preview7
  • [Experimental] DirectTls transport implementation #67912
    area-networking
  • Blazor Gateway: read reverse-proxy config from the app project's config files #67910
  • Harden SignalR `negotiateVersion` parsing. #67908
  • Enable prepend/append detection with the default `ItemComparer` in `Virtualize<TItem>` #67905
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, 11.0-preview7
  • Adding analyzer to warn about JSInterop calls not wrapped in a try catch block #67900
    community-contribution
  • Fix SignalR token retry for thrown 401 errors #67899
    community-contribution

Merged

  • Expose experimental `AnchorMode` and `ItemComparer` on `QuickGrid` #67783
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, feature-blazor-quickgrid, 11.0-preview7
  • SignalR .NET client: make auth refresh work behind a redirecting server (Azure SignalR) #67612
    community-contribution
  • Enforce MultipartHeadersLengthLimit across BufferedReadStream buffers #67840
  • Fix local WASM Components E2E tests returning 404 #67903
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview7
  • Improve `AnchorMode` tests #67639
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, 11.0-preview7
  • Update AngleSharp to latest #67898
    area-infrastructure
  • Update agentic workflows for gh aw v0.82.13 #67901
    area-infrastructure
  • Add IEndpointMetadataProvider to UnauthorizedHttpResult #65611
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • Harden wildcard matching with empty segments inside #67757

Updated

  • Deprecate the Blazor WebAssembly DevServer package #67862
  • Fix authz metadata guard consistency #67742
  • SignInManager: return SignInResult.Failed for expired passkey session challenge #67539
  • Use schema examples for XML comment examples #67894
  • Fix Virtualize scroll jump caused by native overflow-anchor double compensation #67781
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, 11.0-preview7
  • Fix OutputCache caching truncated responses for aborted requests #66954
    community-contribution, pr: pending author input, area-middleware
  • Remove DataAnnotations' ValidationContext from MEV public API #67549
  • Handle passing a Func expression to Map* in ValidationsGenerator and RDG #67821
  • Use ReadOnlyDictionary/ReadOnlyCollection for ValidateContext.ValidationErrors backing collections #67822
  • Warn on Blazor components with Dispose()/DisposeAsync() but no interface #67426
    community-contribution
  • Add analyzer for RazorComponentResult parameter validation #67617
    community-contribution
  • Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) for cookie authentication (prototype) #67388
  • QuickGrid: Add built-in localization for pagination #67678
    community-contribution
  • Reduce SignalR client/protocol allocations on stream-ID and header hot paths #67761
  • Use generated regexes for gRPC JSON parsing #67758
  • ResponseCaching: avoid one-element string[] allocation on vary-by lookup #67759
  • Add OpenApiGenerateEnvironment property support for API description server document generation #63856
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal
